description: This file implements a mock notes service with CRUD operations using localStorage, including functions for listing, retrieving, creating, updating, and deleting notes, with simulated latency.

methods.name: listNotes
methods.description: Fetches a list of notes, optionally filtered by a search term, sorted by last updated date.

methods.name: getNote
methods.description: Retrieves a specific note by its ID.

methods.name: createNote
methods.description: Creates a new note with a title and content, assigns a unique ID, and saves it.

methods.name: updateNote
methods.description: Updates an existing note's title and content by ID.

methods.name: deleteNote
methods.description: Deletes a note by its ID.
